stages.details: Class IDs (0x39, 0x3A, 0x3B, 0x47), registers %R2740..%R2747, coils %M639..%M640, and diagnostic codes (0x0000, 0xEE81..0xEE85) verified bit-exact.

stages.details: Bit-exact synchronization and 16-bit signed masking verified across %R2740..%R2747 and coils %M639..%M640.

stages.details: Pure ST POU verified. Rejected 9/9 ladder constructs with LadderForbiddenError.
